idea-plugin.name: Branch Time Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Tracks the time you spend working on the Git branches of your projects, across every open project in a single IDE-wide view.

  • Automatically creates a tracking entry when you check out a branch — or add one manually.
  • Start, pause, stop and delete tracking for each branch; only one timer runs at a time.
  • Automatic pause on IDE inactivity, on branch switch and on IDE shutdown, so idle and overnight hours are not counted.
  • Daily summary with a per-project and per-branch breakdown, day-by-day navigation and last-7-days totals.

Data is stored locally in <config>/options/branchTimeTracker.xml. The UI is available in English and Italian.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 — Initial release: automatic and manual branch tracking, idle/branch-switch/shutdown auto-pause, daily summary. English and Italian UI.
